levels.kicker_zh: 关卡 01 / 03 · 限时 3 分钟
levels.blurb_zh: 晚十年开工，终点是「差不多」还是差一整截。
levels.blurb_en: Start ten years later: close enough, or a missing stretch.
levels.scenario_zh: 你 30 岁，每月能存 2,000。目标 60 岁。按名义年化 6%、期末年金计。同事说：「先玩 10 年，40 岁再开始存也差不多，反正后面还有 20 年复利会补上。」
levels.scenario_en: You are 30, can save 2,000 a month, aiming at 60. Nominal 6%, ordinary annuity. A colleague says: “Play for 10 years, start at 40 — close enough. Twenty years of compounding will catch it up.”

choices.zh: 差不多。少存的 10 年本金，后面 20 年复利能补上。
choices.en: Close enough. Twenty years of compounding replace the skipped decade.

choices.zh: 差很多。那 10 年既少本金，也少了后面整段的利滚利。
choices.en: Not close. You skip deposits and the interest those deposits would have earned the whole way.

choices.zh: 只要最后存进去的本金总数一样，终点就一样。
choices.en: If total principal is the same, the finish is the same.

levels.kicker_zh: 关卡 02 / 03 · 限时 3 分钟
levels.blurb_zh: 62¢ 按 004 可写成「会发生」。还能不能当 100%。
levels.blurb_en: 62¢ can be written as will-happen. That is not 100%.
levels.scenario_zh: 一个盘口买「会发生」要 0.62。WEEK-004 的写法：赔率 ≥60% 就当会发生，用来写「下个礼拜」。你在排下周计划。
levels.scenario_en: A contract to buy “it happens” is 0.62. WEEK-004’s rule: odds ≥60% count as will-happen when writing next week. You are planning the week.
levels.prompt_zh: 把 62% 当成「一定会发生」，错在哪？
levels.prompt_en: If you treat 62% as certain, what breaks?

choices.zh: 没错。≥60% 就是会发生，日程按 100% 排。
choices.en: Nothing. ≥60% means it happens — schedule it at 100%.

choices.zh: 可以当本周主线，但大约还有 38% 的世界里它不发生，不能删预案。
choices.en: Fine as the week’s main line — about 38% of worlds it doesn’t happen. Keep the other plan.
62% is too low; treat it as will-not-happen.

levels.kicker_zh: 关卡 03 / 03 · 限时 3 分钟
levels.blurb_zh: 5 倍做多，标的跌 12%。本金还剩多少。
levels.blurb_en: 5× long, underlying −12%. What is left of equity.
levels.scenario_zh: 账户权益 10 万，5 倍杠杆做多。标的从 100 跌到 88（−12%）。不计费、全仓。爆仓按权益归零（标的再跌 20% 才触线）。
levels.scenario_en: Equity 100,000, 5× long. Underlying 100 → 88 (−12%). No fees, fully used. Liquidation at equity zero (a −20% spot move).

choices.zh: 0。5 倍碰到两位数跌幅就会爆仓。
